_comment: Example path map for the Bee consumer. Copy to bee-paths.local.json (gitignored) and set the vault-relative output folders for YOUR vault. The bee-processor agent reads bee-paths.local.json at runtime and falls back to these bracketed defaults if it is absent. Vault root is derived from each sentinel's raw_path (the part before raw_subpath), so no absolute path is stored here.
voice_contract: Describe your Voice Observations file's append contract here (where the append marker is, what is allowed). Skip the voice output entirely if no genuinely new pattern emerged.
